description: Navigate to the 'Locate the region' geography activity in GCompris. Select 'South America'. The game will ask you to locate specific countries (e.g., 'Locate Brazil', 'Where is Peru?'). Click on the correct countries on the map to answer. Successfully locate at least 5 countries. After completing at least 5 prompts, take a screenshot of the map showing your progress/score and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/geography_score.png'.
